businessModel: Free consumer browser tied to Zoho ecosystem; paid Ulaa Enterprise edition (Zoho Enterprise Browser)
summary: Chromium-based browser from India's Zoho. Strips Google tracking, adds built-in ad/tracker blocking, five browsing modes, Zoho SSO and Zia AI search, with E2EE sync via a Zoho account.
bestFor: People wanting a de-Googled Chromium with built-in blocking
notFor: People outside the Zoho ecosystem wanting AI features

pros.title: Browsing modes
pros.detail: Personal, Work, Kids, Developer and Open Season modes tune blocking and features.

pros.title: Built-in blocker
pros.detail: Ad and tracker filtering with Standard and Extreme levels, no extension required.

pros.title: Chrome extension support
pros.detail: Chromium foundation lets users install Chrome extensions.

pros.title: Encrypted sync
pros.detail: Bookmarks, passwords and tabs sync via a Zoho account, E2EE per reviews.

pros.title: Current Chromium
pros.detail: Android build 155 on Oct 20, 2026, close to upstream.

cons.title: Default telemetry
cons.detail: Zoho terms say basic usage details are collected by default.

cons.title: Zoho-centric extras
cons.detail: Zia AI and SSO mainly benefit Zoho app users.

cons.title: Modest ecosystem
cons.detail: Reviews note extension compatibility and maturity concerns.

faq.a: Yes, it is Chromium-based and supports Chrome extensions.

faq.q: Which platforms does Ulaa run on?
faq.a: Windows, macOS, Linux, Android and iOS.
Zoho terms say basic usage data such as browser version and OS is collected by default, with more when you sign in or enable Anonymized Stats.
